meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.
meta.coverage: The general government's account as the RBI Bulletin prints it: receipts, spending, the deficit and how it is financed, with the budget estimate, revised estimate and accounts of each year side by side, ₹ crore
meta.note: RBI Bulletin, Combined Receipts and Disbursements of the Central and State Governments (DBIE report 36). Unlike the Handbook tables, this one keeps each year's budget estimate, revised estimate and accounts as separate figures: three series per item, never joined. Totals exclude National Calamity Contingency Fund spending (the table's note 4).
